# OVO

> One AI-native business-delivery family with three independently installable products. Use Askovo for real research, Growovo for delegated growth operations, and Verovo for independent economic intelligence.

## Choose a product

- **Askovo**: Opportunity Research, Demand Validation and Product Intelligence. Start with a product idea, demand assumption or live product to obtain real evidence, counterevidence and a durable decision review.
- **Growovo**: Managed Growth, First Users and Distribution Intelligence. Start with a real product, operating goal and channel authorization to reduce repetitive operations before evaluating activation and growth.
- **Verovo**: Agent Spend Healthcheck, Independent Bill Audit and Agent Economics Optimization. Start with agent logs, a supplier bill or a tool comparison to discover economic problems and verify better options.

All three share one navigation, task workbench, case library, journal and real-task entry. Product identity comes from service content and evidence, not different visual systems.

## Website modules

- [Home](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/): unified product workbench and product switching.
- [Cases](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/cases.html): real research, internal use, negative results and synthetic examples with explicit boundaries.
- [Journal](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/journal.html): six OVO engineering deep dives and agent-economics articles, filterable by product.
- [Get started](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/start.html): installation and real-task entry for all three products.
- [English home](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en.html), [English cases](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en-cases.html), [English journal](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en-journal.html), [English start](https://roy-tong.github.io/ovo/en-start.html).

## Entry points

```bash
pipx install askovo==2.25.1rc1
askovo demo

pipx install growovo==0.23.1rc2
mkt demo

pipx install verovo==0.20.1rc1
verovo review --sample
```

## Product repositories and status

- Askovo 2.25.1rc1 preview: https://github.com/roy-tong/Askovo and https://github.com/roy-tong/Askovo/blob/main/docs/feature-status.md
- Growovo 0.23.1rc2 preview: https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo and https://github.com/roy-tong/Growovo/blob/main/docs/feature-status.md
- Verovo 0.20.1rc1 preview: https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo and https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/docs/feature-status.md

## Evidence and next validation

Askovo’s 109,429 comments are a convenience sample, not users or market share. Growovo’s 73-post launch with zero new Stars is a negative result, not proof that X never works. Verovo’s 110+ repositories and 65+ findings prove technical measurement, not customer savings. The USD 4.50 difference is synthetic, not a customer loss or recovery.

Next validation covers real participants and second decision reviews, seven-day delegated operations and a second valid batch, and a real supplier period with equal-or-better-quality optimization. External first-task use and repeat use are not claimed.
